maria_cs: Quick thread — Cartella QBR prep. onboarding slipped, still on dev key, and we saw a 420k token spike Fri night. need a short mitigation + cost slide. cc @dylan_finops @alex_se

dylan_finops: please drop 30d burn + 30/60/90 forecast. ill craft two commercial paths: prepaid safety-net vs monthly retainer.

noah_data: uploading numbers: 30d=1,240,500 tokens. baseline 30/60/90 -> 1.5M / 1.9M / 2.3M. burst (no guardrails) = 3.8M. top endpoint = /embed/bulk. csv -> drive link.

jenna_csm: onboarding update: SSO blocked on IdP cert, prod key delayed to Apr 5. client wants no surprise bills.

alex_se: quick mitigations: set dev-key rate 10req/min + daily token cap 250k, default embed batch 16, enable prefix cache. CLI: redwoodctl set-policy --key cartella-dev --rate 10/m --daily-tokens 250000

budgetbot: Alert created: cartella-credits-threshold @70% (sub: customer-success).

dylan_finops: rough econ: baseline ~1.5M -> ~$750/mo; burst -> ~$1.9k. propose $2k prepaid or $1.2k retainer with lower overage.

maria_cs: deliverables EOD: noah -> final CSV; dylan -> slide + two options; alex -> PR for policy; jenna -> customer note. sync 09:00 tomorrow.

jenna_csm: ill draft customer-facing bullets: baseline, mitigations, options, emergency top-up flow.

maria_cs: thanks everyone. will send materials to customer 24h prior. :thumbsup:
